name: Haiyuuenchi no Memento Memoria
original_name: 廃遊園地のメメントメモリア
source:
During the World War, children were forced to evacuate their homes.
The land where they gathered and lived became known as "lagoons".
Many "lagoons" are self-sufficient and provide a humane, albeit humble, way of life.

Kai, a young mercenary boy, lives in a "lagoon" that is an abandoned amusement park.
During a joint operation with an adult-centered warlord called "The Army," Kai meets a girl,
Her name is Mio.
She has silver hair.
She is not a talker.
She is good at shooting.
And she is a girl who can't wear bandages.

Kai learns Mio's secret.
He reached out to Mio because he had some thought in his mind.

Mio starts living at Kai's house.
Kai's childhood friend, Doctor, is also with her.

No one knows yet where this encounter will lead.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505800/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大戰期間，孩子們被迫撤離家園。
他們聚居的土地，漸漸被稱為「潟湖」。
許多「潟湖」能夠自給自足，讓人們過上雖簡樸，卻仍不失尊嚴的生活。

少年傭兵凱生活在一座由廢棄遊樂園改建的「潟湖」中。
在與以成年人為主的軍閥「軍隊」聯合作戰時，凱遇見了一名少女。
她叫米歐。
有著一頭銀髮。
不善言辭。
擅長射擊。
卻不會纏繃帶。

凱得知了米歐的秘密。
出於心中的某些想法，他向米歐伸出了手。

米歐開始住進凱的家。
凱的青梅竹馬「博士」也與他們一起生活。

沒有人知道，這次相遇最終會通向何方。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505800/_/]Steam[/url]]
